description: This PHP source file defines the class ExternalSourceEAPMAdapter, which extends ImportDataSource. It serves as an adapter to load contact data from external EAPM sources such as Google via a specific API. The class includes methods for loading datasets, retrieving headers, and implementing iteration protocols, along with setting locale preferences and handling external API interactions.

classes.name: ExternalSourceEAPMAdapter
classes.description: An adapter class for importing contacts from external EAPM sources like Google using the SuiteCRM framework.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the adapter with the name of the EAPM account and sets user locale preferences.

methods.name: loadDataSet
methods.description: Loads contact data from the external EAPM source using the API framework, with optional maximum result limit.

methods.name: getHeaderColumns
methods.description: Returns an empty string, implying no specific header columns are defined.

methods.name: getTotalRecordCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of records retrieved from the external source.

methods.name: setSourceName
methods.description: Sets the source name to the EAPM name provided.

methods.name: current
methods.description: Returns the current record in the iteration.

methods.name: key
methods.description: Returns the current index key during iteration.

methods.name: rewind
methods.description: Resets the iterator to the beginning of the record set.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Advances the iterator to the next record.

methods.name: valid
methods.description: Checks if the current iterator position is valid.
